{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99

# Remove QA orders
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Now check the target population: new customers reached via paid_search
new_paid_search = df_clean[(df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Correctly define conversion: only 'completed' status
n_total = len(new_paid_search)
n_converted = (new_paid_search['status'] == 'completed').sum()
fraction_converted = n_converted / n_total

# Print results
n_total, n_converted, fraction_converted"}
